submitText.title: Submit text for analysis
submitText.description: Send article text and receive an analysis ID. The pipeline runs asynchronously — poll the status endpoint until completed.

submitUrl.title: Submit a URL
submitUrl.description: Pass a URL and the backend will fetch and parse the article content automatically.

getResult.title: Get analysis result
getResult.description: Fetch the full result once status is "completed". Returns credibility score, classification (REAL / FAKE / UNCERTAIN), top keywords, and flagging reasons.

history.title: List your analysis history
history.description: Paginated list of your recent analyses. Supports ?page=N&page_size=N.
